# Company Launches Operations in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam


Oct 4


Written By[Tech Admin GrowHub](https://thegrowhub.co/news?author=62dfa0f218b0af5ca6325224)


Despite temporary working conditions, our company officially launched operations in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam this October 2024. While we eagerly await the completion of our dedicated office space, the Vietnam team is full of enthusiasm for the opportunities ahead and the contributions we’ll make as we continue to grow.


[Tech Admin GrowHub](https://thegrowhub.co/news?author=62dfa0f218b0af5ca6325224)
